GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a half length, Moved Up to Two Wide joint Lead turning, lost a little ground turning, out to the centre of the track Straightening Up , ran on hitting the Lead at the 150m and kept going to post # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to a half length Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led 1.5 Lengths turning, kept going in Straight # always in control
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid out under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Four Wide trailing 0.75 Lengths , tucked in Two Wide approaching turn, trailed 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, shifted wider Straightening Up and Lost Ground in Straight # Wide early
Jumped okay & Went Forward to 1.5 Lengths Lead on fence, joined at 600m, led 2 Lengths jointly turning, Headed 200m and faded a couple of lengths or So to the line # led/faded last 200m
Jumped extra well and quickly went out to a clear lead, led 2.5 Lengths rail turning, raced further and further away down the Straight # Blew them away

Jumped okay, ridden positively & led 3 Wide by a length as the field settled down, led out and crossed at 650m, led 1.5 Lengths rail turning, kept going in Straight and only Headed 20m from post. (Winkers OFF FIRST TIME) [Stewards: App. jockey reported she intended leading and after finding the lead it travelled well, but when pressured on straightening it was inclined to lay out slightly. She opined it failed to see out a strong 1000m.] # led/battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported intention to lead, adding after gelding found the lead, it travelled well but when placed under pressure at the entrance to the home straight, was inclined to lay out slightly-added gelding failed to see out a strong 1000m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , shared Lead but held 3 Wide 500m, wobbled around the corner and was soon under riding, wanted to lay out last 200m and faded to miss placing # green/faded late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover throughout. Laid out around home turn and then under pressure in the straight. Shifted out under riding near the 100m

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly, Wide early stages, worked up to lead Two Wide by a length turning, Headed Straightening Up and Lost Ground in straight. [Stewards: Raced keenly early/middle stages. Unplaced $1-75 favourite. App. jockey reported it raced keenly and wanted to shift around under pressure throughout. Post-race vet exam ordered. Failed to show and left course. Vet clearance incl. ECG and endoscopic exam results required.] # wide/worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and was then bumped. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Wanted to lay out under pressure in the straight. Approaching the 100m when laying out was brushed. Unplaced $1.75 favourite. Rdr reported that her mount raced keenly and wanted to shift around under pressure throughout. After being advised to present IGOTMYMINDONYOU for a veterinary examination post-race, failed to do so and left the course prior to 30 minutes after the running of Race 7. Must produce a vet clearance with ECG and endoscopic examination.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok comf Went Forward Settled Down neck Clear held together same to straightening up gone @ 350m, - Beaten too soon and too far, maybe held its breath - # slow recovery
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping away. Rdr reported gelding may have held its breath and proved disappointing. A post-race vet exam revealed a slow recovery. Tnr advised going for a spell.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly & Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by 0.75 Lengths settling down, crossed at 700m, led rail a half length turning, steered to centre of track Straightening Up and kept going in Straight only being Headed at the 150m. (Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only), Tongue Tie & Winkers -All- FIRST TIME; Lugging Bit OFF FIRST TIME) # led/battled on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and then bumped. Laid out from the 200m when placed under pressure.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Went Forward sat close up Outside the Leader Straightened Up the same run ended 100m # on pace/faded 100
